message.name: SecuritiesSettlementConditionModificationStatusAdviceV11
message.definition: Scope|An account servicer sends a SecuritiesSettlementConditionsModificationStatusAdvice to an account owner to advise the status of a modification request previously instructed by the account owner.|The account servicer/owner relationship may be:|- a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure acting on behalf of their participants|- an agent (sub-custodian) acting on behalf of their global custodian customer, or|- a custodian acting on behalf of an investment management institution or a broker/dealer.||Usage|A SecuritiesSettlementConditionsModificationRequest may contain requests on multiple transactions. However, one SecuritiesSettlementConditionsModificationStatusAdvice must be sent per transaction modified unless the SecuritiesSettlementConditionsModificationRequest is rejected as a whole.|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

rules.name: ReferencePresenceRule
rules.text: At least one reference must be present.

rules.name: WithLinkageRule
rules.text: If Code WITH is used, then the one or more instruction which are linked become bound and which must be executed together. Even if one single transactions/instructions/notifications can not be executed, then all the other transactions/instructions/notifications must also be kept pending. Therefore the use of code WITH must be limited to combine up to 2 or 3 transactions/instructions/notifications.

rules.name: ShortLongNumberRule
rules.text: ShortNumber must contain the FIN message type number of the linked message. LongNumber must contain the XML message identifier of the linked message.

rules.name: ModificationRequestPresenceRule
rules.text: At least one securities settlement conditions modification request type must be present.

rules.name: OtherProcessingRule
rules.text: If OtherProcessing is used, then its usage must be pre-agreed between the sender and receiver.

rules.name: SettlementConditionModificationApplicabilityRule
rules.text: All settlement condition modification request types do not apply to all account servicers.

rules.name: AdditionalReasonInforrmationRule
rules.text: The AdditionalReasonInformation element must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.
